2125264131510976767.en_summary: $SPCX -6% on news that $TSLA and $SPCX have named five directors to hash out details of a potential merger agreement between the two Elon Musk-led firms. Most likely structure is a SPCX-for-TSLA all equity deal, based on today’s market caps and a 25% premium for TSLA would require 52% dilution in SPCX shares. The $3.6T total size would make it the largest merger in corporate history. In these equity-for-equity deals the acquirer’s shares normally fall pre-close. The five directors include three from $TSLA and two from $SPCX. $TSLA is -5.6% and $SPCX -7.7% vs SPX -3.4% since SPCX’s June IPO at $135.
